Guidance & outlook: Looking ahead, we expect to see further improvements as we plan to commercialize our new plant in Kolkata, dedicated to pulses and grains.
Once these plants are operational, we will be well positioned to capitalize on volume growth, particularly given the expected growth in the domestic market.
So, basically, what we are targeting since our company base is agriculture, we are planning to import and, increase our domestic presence in the market.
Growth & demand: Additionally, we are also trying to launch a new plant in Surat, for which we have already acquired land and it will be commissioned in the next financial year.
If you see the results of March ending 23, the major revenue was from sugar exports.
Our consumption demand, our demand for food grains and pulses, everything will increase.
Margins & costs: So, our operating margin will be around 2% to 2.5%.
Whatever margin we gather, that will be on the processing only.
So, if you can… And there is not much difference in the export margin or domestic margin since last two, three years.
Capex & expansion: Within, I think, it will be commissioned in the month of Feb 25.
Government is encouraging to start many plants for manufacturing of ethanol from corn and all that.
And plus we are also in a long, I mean like, once this plant is commissioned, our focus will also be there to establish our brand.
